title: Harkerware Currier Ives 6 1/4" Gold Trim Plate “The Old Homestead In Winter” USA
descriptionText: The Harkerware Currier Ives 6 1/4" Gold Trim Plate features a beautiful landscape and building design titled "The Old Homestead In Winter". This vintage collector's plate is round in shape and is marked with a colonial style. Made in the United States during the mid-20th century, this beige plate is part of the Currier & Ives product line and is stackable, making it a perfect addition to any American culture-themed collection.
